headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 16, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Christian Scott earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Francisco Alvarez led the Mets' offense with two home runs and two RBIs. Meanwhile, the Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a 10-0 victory, handing the Rays their latest loss. Griffin Jax led the Red Sox pitching staff, while Anthony Seigler and Caleb Durbin were among the Rays' top performers at the plate.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's availability. JoJo Romero, a left-handed pitcher for the St. Louis Cardinals, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 14, 2026. Additionally, Brent Rooker, a designated hitter for the Athletics, has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a bone bruise in his left knee. Other players, including Brice Matthews of the Houston Astros, Brad Keller of the Philadelphia Phillies, Tommy Troy of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Rob Zastryzny of the Milwaukee Brewers, Drew Millas of the Washington Nationals, and Nick Mears of the Kansas City Royals, have also been placed on the injured list.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Washington Nationals traded CF Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Houston Astros traded RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash to the Milwaukee Brewers for OF Jadyn Fielder. The Detroit Tigers traded OF Jahmai Jones to the Boston Red Sox for a player to be named later.
